sources.lighthouse: Lighthouse accessibility category via lighthouse-scan.sh (axe-based, Chromium only)
sources.wave: WAVE via the browser method in README (audits/raw/<page>-wave.json)

criteria.name: Non-text Content
criteria.meaning: Every image, icon and graphic has an appropriate text alternative. Decorative images have empty alt.
manualSteps: Tools flag MISSING alt text; only a human can judge WRONG alt text. Review every alt found by the snippet's img-alt inventory.
Check alt text describes purpose, not appearance ('Search' not 'magnifying glass icon'). No filenames as alt.
Confirm decorative images have alt="" (empty), not a description.
Check icon-only buttons/links have an accessible name (aria-label or visually hidden text).

criteria.name: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
criteria.meaning: Alternative provided for audio-only or video-only media.
manualSteps: Use the snippet's media-inventory to locate every <audio>/<video>/embedded player.
Audio-only: a full text transcript must be available near the player.
Video-only (no sound): a text description or audio track describing the visual content.

criteria.name: Captions (Prerecorded)
criteria.meaning: Captions on all prerecorded video with audio.
manualSteps: Play every video with audio; confirm accurate synchronised captions exist (not auto-captions with errors).
For YouTube/Vimeo embeds, check the caption track is real, not auto-generated gibberish.

criteria.name: Audio Description or Media Alternative
criteria.meaning: Audio description or text alternative for prerecorded video.
manualSteps: For each video: is all important visual information also spoken in the soundtrack, or is there an audio-description track or full text alternative?

criteria.name: Captions (Live)
criteria.meaning: Captions on live audio content.
manualSteps: Only applies if the site streams live audio/video (webinars, live events). If none, mark N/A.

criteria.name: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
criteria.meaning: Audio description track for prerecorded video.
manualSteps: For each prerecorded video: audio description provided for visual-only information (or the soundtrack already covers it).

criteria.name: Info and Relationships
criteria.meaning: Semantic markup: headings, lists, tables, landmarks. ARIA-defined structure carries correct levels.
manualSteps: extra-checks validates heading outline and landmarks; still confirm headings match the VISUAL hierarchy (nothing styled as a heading without markup, nothing marked up as a heading for styling).
Check data tables use real <th> with scope, and visual lists are real <ul>/<ol>.
Check form groups (radio sets, checkbox sets) use fieldset/legend or an ARIA equivalent.

criteria.name: Meaningful Sequence
criteria.meaning: DOM order matches visual reading order.
manualSteps: Read the page with CSS disabled (or via screen reader reading order): does the content order still make sense?
Watch for CSS order/flex-direction:row-reverse/grid placement that visually reorders content away from DOM order.

criteria.name: Sensory Characteristics
criteria.meaning: Instructions do not rely on shape, colour, size or position alone.
manualSteps: Search page copy for instructions like 'click the green button', 'see the box on the right', 'the round icon'. Each needs a non-sensory reference too (name/label of the control).

criteria.name: Orientation
criteria.meaning: Content works in both portrait and landscape.
manualSteps: On a phone or in DevTools device mode, rotate between portrait and landscape: no content or function lost, no 'please rotate your device' block.

criteria.name: Identify Input Purpose
criteria.meaning: Autocomplete attributes on name, email and other identified fields.
manualSteps: extra-checks flags likely personal-data fields missing autocomplete. Confirm each flagged field really collects data ABOUT THE USER (then it needs the attribute) and that the token is correct (name, email, tel, street-address, postal-code...).
axe only validates autocomplete values that are present but invalid; it does not flag missing ones.

criteria.name: Use of Colour
criteria.meaning: Colour is never the only means of conveying information. Links in body copy are distinguishable without colour.
manualSteps: Inline links in paragraphs: distinguishable without colour (underline, or 3:1 contrast against surrounding text PLUS a non-colour cue on hover/focus).
Charts, status indicators, form errors: information also conveyed by text, icon or pattern, not colour alone.
Quick test: view the page in greyscale (DevTools Rendering > Emulate vision deficiencies > Achromatopsia).

criteria.name: Audio Control
criteria.meaning: Any audio over 3 seconds can be paused or muted.
manualSteps: If extra-checks flags autoplaying media with sound: confirm a visible pause/mute control exists within easy reach.
If nothing autoplays sound, mark Pass (or N/A if no audio at all).

criteria.name: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.meaning: 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text. Check all states including hover, focus and disabled.
manualSteps: axe/WAVE only test the DEFAULT state and skip text over images/gradients. Manually check: hover, focus, visited and disabled states; text over hero images; placeholder text.
Use the DevTools colour picker or a contrast checker for each flagged pair. Record element, foreground, background, ratio.

criteria.name: Resize Text
criteria.meaning: Site functions correctly at 200% browser zoom with no loss of content or function.
manualSteps: extra-checks catches zoom-blocking meta viewport and horizontal overflow at a 200%-equivalent width. Still do a real browser pass: Cmd/Ctrl+Plus to 200% at 1280x1024.
Check the sticky header, mobile menu, modals and forms still work; no clipped or overlapping text.

criteria.name: Images of Text
criteria.meaning: No text baked into images where real text could be used.
manualSteps: Scan the snippet's image inventory and the pages themselves for images containing text (banners, quotes, stats graphics). Logos are exempt.
Any text-in-image that could be HTML+CSS is a fail.

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.meaning: At 400% zoom (320 CSS px) content reflows with no horizontal scrolling, except maps, video and true 2-D tables.
manualSteps: extra-checks detects horizontal overflow at 320 CSS px and names the offending elements. Confirm in a real browser: 400% zoom in a 1280px window.
Check content is USABLE, not just non-scrolling: menus open, forms submit, nothing overlaps.
List and justify any permitted exceptions (maps, video, data tables).

criteria.name: Non-text Contrast
criteria.meaning: 3:1 for UI component boundaries, form field borders, focus indicators and meaningful graphics.
manualSteps: Check at 3:1 against adjacent colours: form field borders, checkbox/radio outlines, focus rings, icons that carry meaning, chart elements.
Include hover/focus/disabled states. Use the DevTools colour picker on each.

criteria.name: Text Spacing
criteria.meaning: No loss of content when line height, paragraph, letter and word spacing are increased.
manualSteps: extra-checks injects the WCAG spacing values and reports newly clipped/overflowing elements. Visually confirm each flagged element and anything with fixed heights containing text.

criteria.name: Content on Hover or Focus
criteria.meaning: Tooltips and hover panels are dismissible, hoverable and persistent.
manualSteps: For every tooltip, dropdown-on-hover and mega-menu: (1) can you dismiss it with Esc without moving the pointer? (2) can you move the pointer onto the popup without it closing? (3) does it stay until dismissed?

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.meaning: All functionality operable by keyboard alone.
manualSteps: Unplug the mouse. Tab/Shift+Tab through every template: reach EVERY control (menus, accordions, carousels, sliders, custom widgets), operate it (Enter/Space/arrows), and exit it.
Watch for click-only handlers on divs/spans — the extra-checks focus pass lists what is reachable; anything interactive that never receives focus is a fail.

criteria.name: No Keyboard Trap
criteria.meaning: Focus can always move away from a component, including modals and the mobile menu.
manualSteps: Open every modal, video embed and the mobile menu with the keyboard; confirm Tab cycles inside sensibly and Esc (or a close button) always releases focus back to the page.

criteria.name: Character Key Shortcuts
criteria.meaning: Single-character shortcuts can be turned off or remapped.
manualSteps: With focus on the page body (not a field), press letter keys — does anything trigger? If the site has single-key shortcuts, they need a disable/remap option. If none, mark N/A.

criteria.name: Timing Adjustable
criteria.meaning: Any time limit can be turned off, adjusted or extended.
manualSteps: Any session timeouts, auto-redirects, auto-dismissing messages? Each needs to be adjustable/extendable, or exempt (real-time events). If no time limits, mark N/A.

criteria.name: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.meaning: Motion and auto-updating content lasting over 5 seconds can be paused. Applies to scroll-driven/GSAP animation.
manualSteps: extra-checks reports animations still running >5s and whether prefers-reduced-motion is honoured. Confirm: with OS reduced-motion ON, the site renders fully with no autoplaying motion.
Carousels, tickers, background video: each needs a visible pause/stop/hide control if it runs >5s.

criteria.name: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.meaning: No content flashes more than three times per second.
manualSteps: Watch all video and animation for flashing/strobing. If anything is borderline, run it through the free PEAT tool. Usually a quick Pass on corporate sites.

criteria.name: Bypass Blocks
criteria.meaning: Skip to main content link as the first keyboard tab stop.
manualSteps: extra-checks presses Tab once on each page and validates the skip link and its target. Manually confirm activating it actually moves reading/focus position past the nav in Chrome, Safari and Firefox.

criteria.name: Page Titled
criteria.meaning: Unique, descriptive title on every page.
manualSteps: extra-checks verifies presence and cross-page uniqueness. Human check: does each title actually DESCRIBE the page (front-loaded, 'Page — Site' pattern)?

criteria.name: Focus Order
criteria.meaning: Tab order is logical and matches visual order, including after a modal opens or closes.
manualSteps: Tab through each template: order follows the visual layout, no jumps. extra-checks records the actual tab sequence per page — review it.
Open a modal: focus moves in; close it: focus returns to the trigger.

criteria.name: Link Purpose (In Context)
criteria.meaning: Link text describes its destination. No bare 'read more' or 'click here'.
manualSteps: The snippet flags vague link text ('read more', 'click here', 'learn more'). For each: fix the text or give the link a fuller accessible name (aria-label/visually hidden text) that includes the visible text.
Check links to files announce type and size ('Annual report (PDF, 2MB)').

criteria.name: Multiple Ways
criteria.meaning: More than one way to find a page: navigation plus search, sitemap or index.
manualSteps: Count the ways to reach an arbitrary page: main nav, search, sitemap page, related links. Two or more = Pass. Pages that are steps in a process are exempt.

criteria.name: Headings and Labels
criteria.meaning: Headings and form labels describe topic or purpose.
manualSteps: Read the heading outline (extra-checks exports it): does each heading describe its section? Are form labels specific ('Work email' vs 'Input')?

criteria.name: Focus Visible
criteria.meaning: Visible focus indicator on every interactive element. Never remove the outline without a replacement.
manualSteps: extra-checks tabs through each page and flags stops with no detectable style change on focus. Visually confirm each flag, and check the indicator is clearly visible (not a 1px grey ghost) in both light and dark sections.

criteria.name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
criteria.meaning: Focused element is never fully hidden by sticky headers, cookie banners or floating elements. New in WCAG 2.2.
manualSteps: extra-checks flags tab stops whose centre is covered by a fixed/sticky element (advisory — verify each). Manually: Tab through with the cookie banner open and the sticky header active; the focused element must never be COMPLETELY hidden.

criteria.name: Pointer Gestures
criteria.meaning: Multipoint or path-based gestures have a single-pointer alternative.
manualSteps: Any pinch-zoom maps, swipe-only carousels, drag-to-draw? Each needs single-tap/click alternatives (buttons). If none exist, mark N/A.

criteria.name: Pointer Cancellation
criteria.meaning: Actions complete on up-event, not down-event.
manualSteps: Press mouse down on a button, drag off it, release: the action must NOT fire. Native buttons/links pass automatically; test custom mousedown/touchstart handlers.

criteria.name: Label in Name
criteria.meaning: Accessible name contains the visible label text.
manualSteps: axe's label-content-name-mismatch covers most cases. Spot-check controls with aria-label: the visible text must appear inside the accessible name (voice-control users say what they see).

criteria.name: Motion Actuation
criteria.meaning: Device motion functionality has a UI alternative and can be disabled.
manualSteps: Does anything respond to shaking/tilting the device? If not (typical for websites), mark N/A.

criteria.name: Dragging Movements
criteria.meaning: Any drag action has a single-pointer alternative such as a click or arrow keys. New in WCAG 2.2.
manualSteps: Inventory drag interactions: sliders, sortable lists, drag-scroll carousels, map panning. Each needs a click/tap or keyboard alternative. If no dragging exists, mark N/A.

criteria.name: Target Size (Minimum)
criteria.meaning: Interactive targets at least 24x24 CSS px, or adequately spaced. New in WCAG 2.2.
manualSteps: extra-checks measures every interactive element and flags those under 24x24. Review each flag: inline text links are exempt; a small target is still OK if no other target is within a 24px circle around its centre.

criteria.name: Language of Page
criteria.meaning: lang attribute set on the html element.

criteria.name: Language of Parts
criteria.meaning: lang attribute on any passage in a different language.
manualSteps: Any quotes, names of publications or phrases in another language? Each passage needs its own lang attribute. If the site is single-language throughout, mark Pass.

criteria.name: On Focus
criteria.meaning: Receiving focus does not trigger a change of context.
manualSteps: Tab through every page: merely FOCUSING a control must never open a modal, submit a form, move focus elsewhere or navigate.

criteria.name: On Input
criteria.meaning: Changing a setting does not trigger an unexpected change of context.
manualSteps: Change selects, radios and checkboxes with the keyboard: selecting a value must not auto-submit or navigate without an explicit button (or a prior warning).

criteria.name: Consistent Navigation
criteria.meaning: Navigation appears in the same relative order on every page.
manualSteps: extra-checks compares the nav link sequence across all scanned pages and flags outliers. Confirm any flagged page really differs (vs. an intentional section nav).

criteria.name: Consistent Identification
criteria.meaning: Components with the same function are labelled consistently.
manualSteps: Same function, same name everywhere: search field, contact links, download icons, social icons. Flag any component labelled 'Contact' on one page and 'Get in touch' as the same control elsewhere.

criteria.name: Consistent Help
criteria.meaning: Help mechanisms such as contact details appear in the same relative place on every page. New in WCAG 2.2.
manualSteps: extra-checks locates contact/help links per page and flags placement differences. Confirm the help route (contact link, phone, chat) sits in the same relative position across templates.

criteria.name: Error Identification
criteria.meaning: Form errors identified in text and programmatically associated with the field.
manualSteps: Submit each form empty and with invalid data: errors described in TEXT (not just red borders), tied to the field (aria-describedby / id association), and announced by a screen reader.
Focus should move to the first error or an error summary.

criteria.name: Labels or Instructions
criteria.meaning: Every input has a persistent visible label. Placeholder text alone fails.
manualSteps: extra-checks flags fields whose only 'label' is a placeholder. axe only checks that SOME accessible name exists — a visible persistent label is still required. Confirm every field keeps its label while typing.
Required fields and format requirements stated up front.

criteria.name: Error Suggestion
criteria.meaning: Error messages suggest how to correct the input.
manualSteps: Trigger each validation error: does the message say HOW to fix it ('Enter your email in the format name@example.com'), not just 'Invalid input'?

criteria.name: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
criteria.meaning: Submissions are reversible, checked or confirmed.
manualSteps: Only applies to legal commitments, purchases or data deletion. If the site only has contact forms, mark N/A.

criteria.name: Redundant Entry
criteria.meaning: Information already entered is auto-populated or available to select. New in WCAG 2.2.
manualSteps: In any multi-step process: is previously entered info re-requested? It must be auto-filled or selectable. Single-step forms: N/A.

criteria.name: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
criteria.meaning: No cognitive function test in authentication without an alternative. New in WCAG 2.2.
manualSteps: If there is a login: password managers must work (no paste-blocking), and any CAPTCHA needs an alternative that isn't memorising/transcribing/solving puzzles. No login: N/A.

criteria.name: Name, Role, Value
criteria.meaning: Correct name, role and value on all interactive components, including custom ones.
manualSteps: axe catches missing names and invalid ARIA. Manually verify DYNAMIC state: nav toggle announces expanded/collapsed (aria-expanded flips), tabs announce selected, accordions announce state — check the accessibility tree, then listen with NVDA and VoiceOver.
Prefer native elements; strip redundant/wrong ARIA.

criteria.name: Status Messages
criteria.meaning: Dynamic status messages announced via role=status or aria-live.
manualSteps: The snippet inventories existing live regions. With a screen reader running, trigger form success/error, filter results and loading states: each must be announced WITHOUT moving focus (role=status / aria-live=polite).
